glosses: Paying attention; noticing, watching, listening, or attending closely.

examples.text: She is an attentive listener, but does not like to talk much.

King-of-the-Sky was sitting alone in the Leeward Village meeting-house, gesticulating to the attentive shades of night, roaring out the genealogy of his ancestors, telling the sleeping world of his greatness.
a husband attentive to his wife’s needs

glosses: Alert and paying close attention; watchful.

examples.text: The observant police officer noticed that my tax disk was out-of-date.

glosses: Diligently attentive in observing a law, custom, duty or principle; regardful; mindful.

examples.text: I was normally observant of the local parking restrictions.
We are told how observant Alexander was of his master Aristotle.
They also profess Buddhism, but are not so observant of its customs, nor are there so many monasteries and Lamas to be met with as in the other part of Bhutan.
She is an observant Catholic who goes to church regularly.

glosses: present participle and gerund of observe

examples.text: Sensations then, are not perceivings, observings or findings; they are not detectings, scannings or inspectings; they are not apprehendings, cognisings, intuitings or knowings.
Alex McLeish, perhaps mindful of the flak he has been taking from sections of the Villa support for a perceived negative style of play, handed starts to wingers Charles N'Zogbia and Albrighton.

glosses: Of or pertaining to mindfulness; sustaining meta-attention of the contents of one's own mind in the present moment.

examples.text: I think being mindful may help you to appreciate life more.
These noble warriors, mindefull to pursew / The last daies purpose of their vowed fight, / Them selves thereto preparde in order dew […].

glosses: As much as can be held in one's mind at a time.

examples.text: A work of art may exceed a 'mindful' – whatever it is that can be accommodated within a mind at a given time – and may have to be regarded as a series of mindfuls.
So, whereas mouthfuls and servings are the units of fullness, mindfuls and savorings are the units of mind-fullness.
A sketch can hold several mindfuls, allowing designers to see far more than they can imagine, allowing designers to integrate mindfuls.
The teacher kept a watchful eye on her pupils during the school trip.
But there was so much at stake that I had to take some risk—though even when I was far away there has never been a day when the Shire has not been guarded by watchful eyes.
Asami hört aufmerksam zu.
„John Hammond, stets ein aufmerksamer Beobachter der Ereignisse seiner Zeit, erkennt sehr bald, welche Umwälzungen Homer Capeharts Erfindung der Jukebox für die Phono-Industrie bringen wird.“

glosses: jemanden auf etwas/jemanden hinweisen, jemandem etwas/jemanden zeigen oder mitteilen, sodass die Person es bemerkt und darauf achtet, jemandes Interesse auf etwas/jemanden lenken
